_notes: Curated models: one list for every router, matched by the model's own name. The picker's "curated" checkbox shows the entries found on the current key, in this order (cheapest first), each under its label. It is on by default in the DreamGen tools, which these were tested for on 2026-11-09 (on OpenRouter and Requesty).

name: the model's name without its maker or router prefix. It matches any id whose last part is that name, ignoring case, . versus - (claude-haiku-5.5 = claude-haiku-5-5), a date tag (-0731), a region (@eu) and a variant (:flex). When a key lists several, the first plain one is shown.
price: relative, $ (cheapest) to $$$$, never an amount from our tests. note: what the tests found, shown under the picker.

chat: each got Draw the DreamGen Scene's system prompt with a sample session (it must answer the JSON the tool reads), then Animate the DreamGen Scene's motion prompt. All of these answered valid JSON, named the two characters in frame and left out the one who had just left.

image: each got a scene prompt with one reference portrait as AVIF and as WebP (PNG or JPEG where one failed), and kept the portrait's likeness. AVIF was refused by Seedream, Grok Imagine, GPT Image and MAI, and WebP by MAI; JPEG was taken by all, so Draw the DreamGen Scene sends references as JPEG.
